# Official Vibe schema provenance

Revision: `2026-06-01`. Selected endpoint definitions downloaded from official `https://developers.vibe.co/reference/<operation>.md` and OAuth client-credentials guide on 2026-10-07. No credentials were used. SHA256: `f7cef813db52c0d6bbb17f0ee0304f87d3b13ccc6c69764df3c5f92d76d10bb8`.

The API documents `GLOBAL` lifetime strategy budgets, creative `AUTHORIZED` review status, `POST /campaigns/{id}/publish`, async reporting and account balance. It does not expose a separate submit-creative-review action, advertiser approval status, card-number handling or card-failure status in these contracts. Unknown statuses fail closed.
